plugins.name: Lightning 76
plugins.summary: Fast FET compressor. Push Input into it for grab and attitude, then set the level with Output.

plugins.name: Velvet 2
plugins.summary: Optical leveller. Smooth, slow gain riding that holds a vocal steady without sounding squeezed.

plugins.name: Console Glue
plugins.summary: Stereo bus compressor. A few dB of it ties the parts of a mix together and adds punch.

plugins.name: Ember
plugins.summary: Analog saturation in five flavours, from console warmth to diode bite. Drive adds harmonics, Mix blends them in.

plugins.name: Soft S
plugins.summary: De-esser. Turns down harsh S and T sounds when they flare, and leaves the rest of the voice alone.

plugins.name: Punch 250
plugins.summary: Punchy VCA compressor with a choice of knee, detector and thrust, so the low end keeps its weight.

plugins.name: Silk Chorus
plugins.summary: Chorus and stereo doubler. Vintage for a classic swirl, Double to widen a voice with no sweep, Ensemble for lush strings-like thickness.

plugins.name: Orbit Phaser
plugins.summary: Analog-style phaser with 2 to 12 stages. Gentle movement at low depth, deep swirling notches with feedback up.

plugins.name: Dust Lab
plugins.summary: Lo-fi converter. Fewer bits and a slower clock for sampler grit, or cassette and broken-radio colour.

plugins.name: Precision 10
plugins.summary: Ten-band parametric EQ. Drag a point to shape the sound; every band can be a bell, shelf, cut or notch.

plugins.name: Reel
plugins.summary: Tape machine. Drive it for warmth and gentle compression of the top end; add wow, flutter and hiss to taste.

plugins.name: Skyspace
plugins.summary: Reverb with three engines: a dense studio plate, a wide open sky, and a shimmer that blooms an octave up.

plugins.name: Pure Voice Pro
plugins.summary: Neural voice cleaner. Separates the voice from room and noise, then lets you choose how much of each to keep, band by band.

plugins.name: Mic Studio
plugins.summary: Microphone colours: the lift of a condenser, the bite of a dynamic, a ribbon's dark warmth or a valve mic's glow, with air and body.

plugins.name: Amp Room
plugins.summary: Guitar amp and cabinet: a valve preamp, a three-band tone stack, presence, a pushed power stage and a speaker cabinet.

plugins.name: Caves Glue
plugins.summary: Slow, low-ratio compression that holds a stem together without pumping.

plugins.name: Caves Slap
plugins.summary: One short rockabilly slap-back, 110 ms, no repeats.

plugins.name: Caves Heat
plugins.summary: Tube warmth. Drive it for harmonics, tame the top with Tone, blend with Mix.

plugins.name: Caves Wide
plugins.summary: Opens the stereo image above the bass and adds a touch of air.
